services.title: What makes your customers leave, I fix

items.title: Your idea doesn't exist yet
items.pain: Every month without a product helps your competitors, and a wrong technical choice at the start costs you for years.
items.promise: A useful first version, an architecture that holds, and publication on the stores.

items.title: Your app breaks in production
items.pain: Payment fails on a Friday night and your customers notice before you do.
items.promise: Automated tests on the paths that bring money, checked releases, instant rollback.

items.title: Nobody understands the code anymore
items.pain: Every fix breaks something else, and the announced migration was never done.
items.promise: A clear audit, a migration plan in small steps, and tests as a safety net.

items.title: Your users wait, then leave
items.pain: Three seconds too many or a dropped network: they uninstall without a word.
items.promise: Screens that respond, even on a small phone and an unstable network.

items.title: Your notifications don't arrive
items.pain: A missed ride, a payment confirmed without anyone knowing, or so many messages that the app gets muted.
items.promise: Reliable push notifications, sorted by channel, with reminders that don't wear people out.

method.title: No surprises, from the first call to launch

steps.d: A first call to understand the real need, before any line of code.
items: Who your users are and what they must be able to do
Your constraints: deadlines, budget, stores, payment methods
steps.out: A written summary of needs and priorities

steps.t: I study what exists, or I design
steps.d: Depending on your situation, I start from your code or from a blank page.
items: Existing app: I read the code, the database and the release setup
Risks ranked from most to least urgent
New project: technical choices, data, web, mobile and API split

steps.d: No long tunnel: every step delivers something you can try.
items: Essential paths first: signup, ordering, payment
One short step at a time, approved with you

steps.d: The code moves in small deliveries, with tests on what matters.
items: Automated tests on signup, payment and notifications
Every fixed bug becomes a test so it never comes back
A test version you open on your phone or browser
steps.out: A testable version at every step

steps.d: The release is prepared, checked and reversible.
items: New version checked before the switch, old one ready for rollback
Publishing on Google Play, the App Store or the Amazon Appstore if needed
steps.out: Your app live, used by your customers

steps.d: After launch, I keep an eye on it and leave you autonomous.
items: Error alerts on app and server with Sentry
steps.out: A monitored app and an autonomous team
